key_concepts: In a parallel circuit, components are connected across the same two points
The voltage across each branch of a parallel circuit is equal to the source voltage
The total current in a parallel circuit is the sum of the individual branch currents
Total resistance in a parallel circuit is found using the reciprocal formula

Ohm's law relates voltage, current, and resistance as V = IR

Parallel circuits allow components to operate independently if one branch fails
Household appliances and electrical components are commonly connected in parallel
Adding more parallel branches increases total current drawn from the source
